panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Real patient lung biopsy histology from a case report of cryptogenic organizing pneumonia. Panel A (H&E ×10) shows the textbook patchy filling of alveoli and respiratory bronchioles by loose granulation-tissue plugs (Masson bodies) with preserved alveolar architecture; panel B (H&E ×40) shows the swirled intra-airway fibroblastic plugs diagnostic of organizing pneumonia. Both panels visibly show specific COP manifestations, attributed to COP by the caption, in-text description and disease-focused article title. B: High-power H&E (×40) view of the same real patient lung biopsy, showing the characteristic swirled intra-airway plugs of fibroblasts and inflammatory cells (Masson bodies) that define organizing pneumonia. Attribution to cryptogenic organizing pneumonia is supported by the caption and the disease-focused case-report title.
